reviewer: Kimi first actually reviewed the complete unchanged RGB raw and original full-rectangle source, then created one bilinear source-alpha derivative only after RGB art approval, actually viewed the complete derivative and its full white/cyan/alpha sheet, and verified the real command JSON receipt, parent/derived hashes and unchanged RGB/backplate against the naiwa reference

entries.positive_observation: The complete RGB raw was art-approved before any alpha operation. Both thick dark eyebrows are visibly restored beneath the cap brim. The dark-green cap retains its silver eagle, circular cockade in a silver wreath and silver braided cord, with short dark temple/sideburn hair, no glasses and a clean-shaven smooth chin. The frontal direct-gaze pose has one calm closed mouth. The dark-green tunic retains a red-piped standing collar, two silver-edged rectangular collar tabs, two red-edged braided silver shoulder ornaments, one central silver button below the collar and one pale blue-and-white sash over viewer left, with no tie or medals. The rounded lower head meets a short broad fitted collar. The original warm light gray-beige full-rectangle photographic backplate remains complete and visually opaque; no paper note, separate frame, transparent exterior or invented scene was added.
entries.alpha_decision: The approved RGB bytes were left unchanged while the original source alpha was resized bilinearly to 1776x2368. The real receipt verifies rgb_unchanged=true and alpha_matches_resized_source=true. Source, resized and output corner alpha are all [251,251,255,255], and actual source/output alpha extrema are [251,255]. White/cyan/alpha review shows a complete opaque backplate with no holes; cyan side strips in the review sheet are panel letterboxing, not output transparency. This is a derived alpha-repaired file, not a native transparent return.
entries.visible_limitations: The finest internal heraldry within the small cap badges is not fully readable at source scale. Their visible shapes, counts and placement were checked without inventing details; the two eyebrows, full backplate and alpha/RGB binding are directly verified.
